title.narrative: Up-Scaling Community Resilience through Ecosystem-based Disaster Risk Reduction (Eco-DRR) Priority area 4 Views from the Frontline (VFL) 2019

description.narrative: The Views from the Frontline (VFL) 2019 programme aims to strengthen inclusion and collaboration between governments, at-risk people and civil society in risk-reduction/resilience-building policies and practices. Its specific objectives are: 1.To establish a citizen-based process to measure local progress in inclusive risk governance, 2.To strengthen in-country civil society monitoring, DRR and advocacy capacities and 3.To support establishment of local-level baselines and generate local risk information to inform policy and local plans
